title: 第19章 交易上第20章 交易下
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
一炷香后，云岫烟也出现在众人眼前，一身紫色锦裙，乌发松松地披着，刚一出面，就牢牢地吸引所有人的目光。
身后跟着八名女侍，排成两列，鱼贯而入。
女侍端着红木长盘一一放在众人面前，只见其中有一玉壶，一颗灵玉果，两只玉盘，一盘清蒸灵鱼，一盘切鹿肉。
顾安看的分明，那清蒸灵鱼就是用自己的黑灵鱼做的。
怪不得昨夜死了八条灵鱼，让自己一举突破，原来是要招待同门。
另外三样也不简单，酒是一阶中品灵酒，不知是什么名字，虽然不多，只一小壶，但酒液清澈，灵香四溢，不是凡品。
灵玉果乃是一阶下品灵果，三日前云岫烟赠给顾安两颗，今日更是一次性拿出八颗。
鹿肉则是一阶中品妖兽巨角鹿所制成，细腻紧实，有七八片。
这一套下来至少得有个六、七块灵石，加起来约莫是五十块灵石。
顾安咂了咂嘴，惊叹于云家之大气。
云岫烟跟着七位同门一一打了招呼，坐了下来，清声开口，“感谢诸位同门赏光，岫烟在此略备薄酒，恭候清晖。”
众人起身谢过，其中属谭乘风说的最大声，“云师妹太客气了，同门小会对大家都有帮助，却让师妹破费，吾等真是羞愧。”
其余人也连声附和，手上却不客气，倒酒的倒酒，吃菜的吃菜，好不热闹。
顾安见各位师兄师姐都动了筷子，也不再客气，先品尝了下清蒸黑灵鱼，一块鱼脸肉入口，感觉滑嫩非常，一股微弱的灵气随之散开。
顾安微微点头，感觉比白芷、青榴的手艺好，不由得心中感叹，“这条鱼命真好，死后都比他兄弟好吃，还懂得为主人着想，一鱼三吃，灵气、灵石和鱼肉兼得，不错。”
“我愿称之为年度最懂感恩的鱼。”
为了表扬这条黑灵鱼，顾安把它吃了个精光。
酒过三巡，菜过五味。
云岫烟放下玉箸，用灵酒漱口后，清冷的声音如珠落玉盘般响起。
“诸位同门，我云国地处偏远，交流来往多有不便，因此岫烟今日举办此会以互通有无，感谢诸位同门的捧场。”

“如诸位有交易需求，可上前展示灵物，买卖皆可。”
“我等晓得了，云师妹快开始吧。”谭乘风笑着开口，他实力最高，少有顾忌。
云岫烟环视一圈，见没人有意见，瑶步轻挪，上前一步。
纤纤玉手抚过储物袋，从中取出三物，说道：“那岫烟就先来抛砖引玉。”
“诸位请看，这三件分别是破障丹，金风剑，撼地锤。”
“破障丹乃一阶上品灵丹，对突破炼气后期有奇效。”
“金风剑和撼地锤都是一阶上品法器，前者是金属性，后者是土属性，品质上佳。”
“岫烟所求的是炼制筑基丹的灵药，若有天元果、龙血草、养魂花这三种主药的任意一种，可全部换取，且另有补偿。”
亭中一时哑然，筑基丹是有助于炼气突破筑基的灵丹，内含精气神三宝，正合筑基肉身升华，灵气化液，神识蜕变三关，能提高三成筑基成功率，珍贵异常。
就算是只换灵药，也是难上加难，怪不得要举办这同门小会，请众人吃灵膳，原来在这等着呢！
毕竟也就只有青元宗弟子有机会在宗门换取筑基丹，才有可能拿出灵药来换。
反正捏着一两株灵药也没用，不如换成各类灵物，提升实力，去争取宗门的筑基丹。
云岫烟身为青霄真人弟子，本身又是二灵根天才，青元宗不会缺了她那一颗筑基丹，那这药材就是云家自己换取的，云家又有谁要突破筑基？
content_en:
After burning the incense, Yun Xiuyan also appeared in front of everyone, wearing a purple brocade dress and her black hair hanging loosely. As soon as she appeared, she firmly attracted everyone's attention.
Behind him, eight female waitresses lined up in two rows and filed in.
The waitress brought long mahogany plates and placed them in front of everyone one by one. Among them was a jade pot, a spiritual jade fruit, two jade plates, one plate of steamed spiritual fish, and one plate of cut venison.
Gu An could see clearly that the steamed spiritual fish was made from his own black spiritual fish.
No wonder eight spiritual fish died last night, allowing me to break through in one fell swoop. It turned out that I wanted to entertain my fellow disciples.
The other three items are not simple either. The wine is a first-order mid-grade spiritual wine. I don’t know its name. Although it is not much, it is only a small pot, but the wine is clear and the aroma is overflowing. It is not an ordinary product.
The Ling Jade Fruit is a first-level low-grade spiritual fruit. Yun Xiuyan gave Gu An two of them three days ago, and today he took out eight of them at once.
The venison is made from the giant-antlered deer of the first-level mid-grade demonic beast. It is fine and firm, with seven or eight pieces.
This set requires at least six or seven spiritual stones, which adds up to about fifty spiritual stones.
Gu An smacked his lips, marveling at the grandeur of the Yun family.
Yun Xiuyan greeted her seven fellow disciples one by one, sat down, and said in a clear voice, "Thank you all for the honor. Xiuyan will prepare some wine here and wait for Qinghui."
Everyone stood up and thanked them. Among them, Tan Chengfeng said the loudest, "Junior sister Yun is so polite. My fellow student will be helpful to everyone, but it costs junior sister money. We are really ashamed."
The rest of the people also echoed, but they were not polite with their hands. Those who poured wine poured wine, and those who ate vegetables ate. It was very lively.
When Gu An saw that all the brothers and sisters were using their chopsticks, he was no longer polite. He tasted the steamed black spirit fish first. A piece of fish cheek meat entered his mouth. It felt very smooth and tender, and a weak spiritual energy spread out.
Gu An nodded slightly, feeling that his craftsmanship was better than that of Angelica dahurica and Qingliu. He couldn't help but sigh in his heart, "This fish has a good life. It tastes better than his brothers even after death. He also knows how to consider the owner. He eats three fish from one fish and gets both spiritual energy, spiritual stone and fish meat. Not bad."
"I would call it the most grateful fish of the year."
In order to praise this black fish, Gu An ate it all.
After three rounds of wine, five flavors of food.
Yun Xiuyan put down the jade chopsticks and rinsed her mouth with spiritual wine. A cold voice sounded like beads falling on a jade plate.
"Fellow disciples, our country of Yun is located in a remote location, and communication is very inconvenient. Therefore, Xiuyan holds this meeting today to exchange information. Thank you all for your support."
"If you have any trading needs, you can come forward and display the spiritual objects. You can buy or sell them."
"I understand, Junior Sister Yun, let's get started." Tan Chengfeng said with a smile. He was the most powerful and had few scruples.
Yun Xiuyan looked around and saw that no one had any objections. Yao moved lightly and took a step forward.
The slender hand stroked the storage bag, took out three items, and said: "Then Xiuyan will come first to attract others."
"Everyone, please take a look. These three items are the Barrier-Breaking Pill, the Golden Wind Sword, and the Earth-shaking Hammer."
"The Barrier-Breaking Pill is a first-level high-grade elixir that has a miraculous effect on breaking through the late stages of Qi refining."
"The Golden Wind Sword and the Earth-shaking Hammer are both first-order high-grade magic weapons. The former is metallic and the latter is earth-based, and they are of high quality."
"What Xiuyan wants is the elixir for refining the Foundation Building Pill. If there is any one of the three main medicines: Tianyuan Fruit, Dragon Blood Grass, and Soul-Nourishing Flower, he can exchange them all with additional compensation."
The pavilion was speechless for a moment. The Foundation Establishment Pill is a spiritual elixir that helps refine qi and break through the Foundation Establishment. It contains the Three Treasures of Essence, Qi, and God, which are in line with the three levels of physical sublimation, spiritual energy transformation, and spiritual transformation. It can increase the success rate of Foundation Establishment by 30%. It is extremely precious.
Even if it is just to exchange for the elixir, it is still very difficult. No wonder we have to hold this small gathering of fellow disciples and treat everyone to a spiritual meal. They are waiting here!
After all, only Qingyuan Sect disciples have the opportunity to exchange for Foundation Establishment Pills in the sect, and can they offer the elixir in exchange.
It's useless to hold on to one or two elixirs anyway. It's better to switch to various spiritual objects, increase your strength, and fight for the sect's foundation-building elixir.Yun Xiuyan is a disciple of Qingxiao and a genius with two spiritual roots. The Qingyuan Sect will not lack her foundation-building pill, so this medicinal material was obtained by the Yun family themselves. Who in the Yun family wants to break through the foundation-building pill?
